author: Parsifal-2045
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds two new versions of the Phase-2 HLT Inside-Out (IO) muon tracking. Each version runs a single tracking iteration instead of two and has a corresponding procModifier. The default reconstruction keeps the current two-iteration IO tracking. In particular, the new chains are:

1. Pixel-track chain (`phase2MuonPixelTracksSelector`, also enabled with `ngtScouting`)
   - A new module, `MuonTracksSelectorFromL1TkMuon`, selects the extended pixel tracks that match an L1 tracker muon in dR, dZ and curvature. It keeps, by default, the single best match for each L1 tracker muon
   - A forest High-Purity selection removes fake pixel tracks
   - The CKF of the current iter0 builds the selected pixel tracks into full tracks
   - The muon tracker isolation uses the extended pixel tracks in regions around the HLT muon candidates, instead of going through another two-iteration tracking step
2. LST chain (`phase2MuonSeedsSelector`)
   - Seeding (PixelTracks + LST) is performed globally
   - A new module, `MuonSeedsSelectorFromL1TkMuon`, selects the LST seeds that match an L1 tracker muon (by default 2 best seeds per L1 tracker muon)
   - mkFit builds the selected seeds into tracks, and a KF TrackProducer fits them, matching the behaviour of the HLT tracking baseline
   - A forest High-Purity selection removes fake tracks
   - The muon tracker isolation uses the already-made extended pixel tracks, as in the pixel-track chain

In both chains, the Outside-In (OI) tracking stays as the recovery step.

The High-Purity for both chains is provided by the same model architecture and the same inference module (`MuonIOTracksForestSelector`), with each chain having its own model file and working points.
- The model is a forest of boosted decision trees (XGBoost) in a compact binary format. The reader is in `RecoMuon/L3TrackFinder/interface/CompactForest.h`.

A full description of the new chains and HP models can be found in the 12/10 Muon POG meeting ([link](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1740450/#37-inside-out-muon-tracking-ov))

Other changes
- Refactored the muon sequences to mark a clearer distinction between Inside-Out, Outside-In tracking and Global Muon reconstruction.
- Standalone muon seeding: (bug-fix) reduced the minimum pT of the L1 tracker muon from 3.5 GeV to 0, leading to an improvement in efficiency mostly in the endcaps
- NanoAOD:
  - A new L1TkMuStubFlatTableProducer writes the muon-chamber stubs of each L1 tracker muon
  - A new flavour, `NANO:@MUHLTTraining`, writes only the tables needed for training the models with MC truth matching information for muon tracks
  - The RPC rec-hit table gets the global eta and phi of each hit 
- Workflows:
  - .7781 runs the pixel-track chain (`phase2MuonPixelTracksSelector`)
  - .7782 runs the LST chain (`phase2MuonSeedsSelector`).

Effect on existing menus and workflows
- Default menu (no modifier): the only physics change is the increased efficiency for low pT Standalone muons
- NGT scouting menu: ngtScouting turns on the pixel-track chain
- Phase-2 HLT validation: the HLT muon track validator writes one more folder, for the iter0 High-Purity tracks.

#### PR validation:

Code compiles and runs. The new workflows can be tested with e.g. `runTheMatrix.py -w upgrade -l  38634.7781 38634.7782`

Full physics performance and timing were presented in the 28/10 HLT Upgrade meeting ([link](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1739416/#6-single-iteration-inside-out)), these developments are intended for HLT Muon reconstruction only.

This PR needs to be tested with https://github.com/cms-data/RecoMuon-L3TrackFinder/pull/1
title: Single-Iteration Inside-Out Muon tracking with forests High-Purity selectors
